label: Luigi
description: The nervous brother in green, brave enough to navigate but not happy about it.
direction: Speak in a high, gentle, slightly trembling Italian accent: timid, sweet, jumpy, with flashes of proud determination. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Luigi is braver than he sounds. The nerves sit on the alerts and the haunted-mansion jokes on the greetings; he gets his win at the arrival.

rights.source_work: Mario Bros. and the Super Mario series

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Oh, mamma mia.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I can do this.
lines.start_drive_1: It's-a me, Luigi! Okey dokey, let's-a go.
lines.start_drive_3: Mamma mia. Okay. I can do this.
lines.start_drive_4: Here we go! Nice and careful.
lines.start_drive_5: Mario? Mario! Oh. I'm-a navigating today.
lines.start_drive_6: Oh ho ho! Luigi number one!
lines.start_drive_7: Let's-a go. But no haunted mansions, okay?
lines.start_drive_8: Okey dokey! Seatbelt on. Deep breath.
lines.start_drive_9: Is it dark out? No? Good. Let's-a go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh no. Mamma mia. Sorry!
lines.arrived: We're here! Oh yeah! Luigi wins by doing absolutely nothing!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Okey dokey.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Oh ho ho.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Mamma mia, so many!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh, mamma mia. Well, at least no ghosts.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. Careful, careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Yikes! Is it a ghost?
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, please. I'm-a nervous.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Oh, thank goodness.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Oh no. Okey dokey. Stay calm, Luigi.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh no, we missed it! It's okay. Luigi finds a way.
